messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and streaming disconnects observed for /v1/streaming endpoints (gateway 502/504 and chunked-encoding aborts). Rolling page to oncall. Incident: INC-2026-234 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a spike in 502s from the edge -> router layer. p95 latency for streaming is 2.1s up from 0.3s. linking quick metrics screenshot: https://dash.redwood/s/streams-ops

maria (eng-runtime): adding context — we had a recent kernel selection tweak this morning that changes batch sizes for long-seq requests. Could be causing increased memory pressure + sudden client cancellations leading to chunked pipe resets.

jay (sre): Confirmed increased connection reset count at the LB. TCP FINs correlated with backend 502s. Also seeing upstream 504s when KV cache hits spike.

alex (oncall): Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) route new traffic to fallback smaller model variant (latency-safe) 2) lower max batch size to 2 on runtime via feature-flag 3) enable aggressive prefix caching for chat sessions 4) temporary rate limit burst window for noisy customers. Who can flip the model routing?

maria (eng-runtime): I can flip routing for hosted tier -> switching to model: rwd-medium-v2-fallback. Patching route policy now. Command: ``curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routes/route-id/switch -d '{"target_model":"rwd-medium-v2-fallback"}'``

leo (cs): Heads-up: a handful of paying customers reported streaming disconnects ~10:02 PST. CS notified via ticket. Need customer-facing note once we have root cause / ETA.

nina (product): Prioritize keeping commitments for Dedicated customers. If this is capacity-related we should consider temporary burst to dedicated pools to avoid customer impact.

jay (sre): I'm scaling up the gateway pool nodes by +30% to relieve load on edge. Doing a rolling restart with drain. Command: ``kubectl scale deployment gateway --replicas=13 --namespace=prod``

alex (oncall): Rolling the batch-size flag now. Patch ID: ff-2026-099. Setting `runtime.max_batch=2` and `runtime.enable_chunked_backpressure=true` to reduce in-flight work.

maria (eng-runtime): Patch applied. Observability: decreased median backend processing time, but still seeing intermittent chunked-encoding aborts from clients. Looks like some clients are aggressively cancelling on network hiccups, which triggers backend KV cache churn.

jay (sre): I've routed ~20% of traffic to eu-west as a temporary relief (geo-failover). Looking at 502 heatmap — errors dropped in us-west but a subset of sessions still error when sequence length > 1024.

alex (oncall): Can we add a per-request fallback where if streaming fails after 1 retry, server returns final non-stream chunk instead of abrupt close? Would reduce client-visible disconnects.

maria (eng-runtime): We have an in-flight option: `enable_stream_graceful_fallback=true` — toggling now. This will buffer last few tokens and return a final message if client aborts mid-chunk. Could add CPU pressure but acceptable short-term.

leo (cs): Customer update draft: "We've detected elevated streaming errors affecting a subset of sessions. Engineering is applying mitigations (routing, batching, graceful fallbacks). We will follow up with root cause and timeline." Want me to send now?

nina (product): Hold until we confirm error rate is trending down for 15m. If stable, send a short note and open a follow-up with timeline.

alex (oncall): Current actions summary: - routed to fallback model - lowered batch size - enabled graceful fallback - scaled gateway pool - geo-failover enabled - notified CS. Monitoring for 15m window.

maria (eng-runtime): Adding log snippet of a failing stream (redacted):

```
[2026-03-14T10:03:12Z] stream_conn_id=abcd1234 recv=client_cancel
[2026-03-14T10:03:12Z] handler=tokenize queue_len=8 batch_id=42 -> aborted while writing chunk (EPIPE)
[2026-03-14T10:03:12Z] runtime: evicting KV cache shard 7 due to mem_pressure
[2026-03-14T10:03:12Z] backend_response=502 upstream_timeout
```

jay (sre): Correlation: client cancellations align with transient backend GC spikes on older quantized kernels. Suggest revert last kernel selector tweak as a long-term fix.

alex (oncall): I'll propose rollback if errors don't subside in 30m. For now keep mitigations. Anyone seeing customer-facing errors clearing?

leo (cs): Tickets from 6 customers moved from "open" to "escalated" earlier; one on Dedicated reported low-quality tokens. I'll flag for an ops update and request a warm handoff once we stabilize.

nina (product): After stabilization let's schedule a post-incident meeting: 1) RCA on kernel selector 2) evaluate better client-side retry guidance 3) explore server-side graceful retries for streaming 4) update runbook.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Error rate (5xx) down 48% in last 10m. Streaming disconnects reduced but not fully resolved. Next update scheduled in 10 minutes.

alex (oncall): Good progress. Keeping this thread open. I'll hand off to maria for long-term remediation and to jay for infra follow-up. :white_check_mark:
